evals.name: first-graph-query
evals.prompt: Set up Cratis.Arc.Neo4j in an Arc host and write a model-bound query that lists the members of a group from a MEMBER_OF graph. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Package install, Cratis:Neo4j options with Server and EventStore and PasswordSecret, WithNeo4j(), and a static [ReadModel] query using IGraphSession.Query with a parameterized Cypher.
assertions: Installs Cratis.Arc.Neo4j and calls WithNeo4j() or AddCratisNeo4j(), not both.
Configures Server and EventStore and names the password by PasswordSecret instead of writing it.
Writes a static query on a [ReadModel] taking IGraphSession and calling Query<T> with a parameterized Cypher string.
Passes the group id as a parameter object and does not concatenate it into the Cypher.
States the session is read-only and the graph is changed by appending events.

evals.name: database-naming
evals.prompt: With event store Orders and no prefix, what database does Arc use for namespaces Default, Acme, Acme Corp and for event store 1Orders in Default? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: orders, orders-acme, orders-acme-corp-fd6ee09c, and g-1orders, explained by lower-casing, replacing invalid characters, the g- prefix and the SHA-256 suffix.
assertions: Gives orders for Default and orders-acme for Acme, noting case alone adds no hash.
Gives orders-acme-corp-fd6ee09c for Acme Corp and explains the 8-hex SHA-256 suffix of the unsanitized name.
Gives g-1orders because the name does not start with a letter.
Says the name must equal what Chronicle's Neo4j sink writes.
Does not hand-build names when GraphDatabaseName.For is available.

evals.name: single-database-tenancy
evals.prompt: We run Neo4j Community Edition in Single database mode. How do we keep tenants apart in our Arc queries? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Use the $namespace parameter against the _namespace property on every node pattern; Single mode is for development and tests only.
assertions: Filters every node pattern with _namespace = $namespace.
States Single mode is for development and tests, not production, because only the filter separates tenants.
Notes the $namespace parameter is added by the session and is harmless in PerNamespace mode.
Mentions Parameters or the session adds the parameter when running through the driver directly.
Does not suggest a singleton capturing IGraphSession.

evals.name: test-the-query
evals.prompt: Write a specification for GroupMember.MembersOf that needs no Neo4j server and proves the namespace is bound. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: UseGraphSessionSubstitute, Returns with a Cypher fragment, calling the query, and asserting Executions parameters including $namespace.
assertions: Installs Cratis.Arc.Neo4j.Testing and calls UseGraphSessionSubstitute() on a service collection.
Sets up rows with Returns and a Cypher fragment.
Calls the query with the substitute as the session.
Asserts on Executions including the converted parameters.
Notes Run and Session throw on the substitute and need an integration test.
